title: Is your resume missing this? ✍️
description:
Did you know you can use AI to review your resume? If you think your resume needs a boost check out the Teal Resume Builder’s “Matching Mode”. The tool pulls the keywords from the job description and compares them against your resume. Keywords are a MUST HAVE on your resume because they show how your career experience can apply to the job you’re after. Check it out and let us know what you think! #resumebuilder #resumetips #resume
